### While You Wait, God Works
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-june-4-2026.html
Passage: Micah 7:7
Points:
- Waiting is an inevitable season of life during which God continues working for our good.
- Human nature demands immediate answers, but God's eternal timing cannot be rushed.
- Learning to trust God while waiting prevents a lifetime spent in doubt and impatience.
- Delays in prayer are not outright denials; they cultivate the enduring faith that God blesses.
